note: Measured on the dev machine (8 GB CPU, Groq generator). hit_rate@final-k and per-query latency over all 44 golden questions. Retrieval+rerank only (no LLM). bge-reranker-base runs on CPU via fastembed ONNX.
findings: hit_rate already saturated at k=4 on this 26-doc corpus, so reranking does not improve recall and adds ~1.3-2.8s median latency on CPU. pool 20 slightly worsens hit_rate (ref doc pushed out of top-4). Rerank's benefit is context precision (ordering), visible via Ragas or on a larger corpus. Best candidate pool here: 8.
